Adversarially verify this code-review finding from the M12 diff. Read the actual code (git diff main...HEAD + the file) and try to REFUTE it. Default to isReal=false if it's a false positive, pre-existing, out of scope, or already handled.

Lens: reuse
Severity: medium
File: components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx (UpcomingBookings render, line 77 — `{item.providerName} · {item.blockMinutes} min`)
Title: Hardcoded "min" suffix bypasses messages/en.json
Detail: The minutes label is rendered as a hardcoded `{item.blockMinutes} min` string in JSX. This violates CLAUDE.md rule 7 (all user-facing copy through messages/en.json) and is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase, which renders minutes via i18n everywhere else: `t("provider.minutesShort", { minutes })` (SessionsTable, IncomingRequests, provider dashboard), `t("summary.minutesValue", { minutes })` (session summary), and `t("receipt.minutes", { minutes })` (the receipt route in this same diff). The literal " min" will not localize.
Suggestion: Reuse an existing minutes message key (e.g. the diff already added `receipt.minutes` = "{minutes} min"), or add an `account.minutesShort` key, and render `t("...", { minutes: item.blockMinutes })` instead of the bare ` min` literal.

All claims are fully verified:

1. **The hardcoded string exists and is new** — `components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx` is a brand-new file (129 insertions, from `/dev/null`) introduced in the M12 diff. Line 77 (line 83 in the diff) renders `{item.providerName} · {item.blockMinutes} min` with a bare literal " min" — not pre-existing.

2. **It violates CLAUDE.md rule 7** (all user-facing copy through `messages/en.json`). The " min" suffix is user-facing copy hardcoded in JSX.

3. **It is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase** — every other minutes render uses i18n:
   - `t("provider.minutesShort", { minutes })` in SessionsTable, IncomingRequests, provider dashboard
   - `t("summary.minutesValue", { minutes })` in session summary
   - `t("receipt.minutes", { minutes })` in the receipt route — and `receipt.minutes` = `"{minutes} min"` was added in this same M12 diff

4. **The component already imports `t`** (line 12) and uses it 11 other times in the same file, so the fix is trivial and the i18n infrastructure is right there.

5. **The detail's specifics check out** — `provider.minutesShort` (line 210), `summary.minutesValue` (line 332), and `receipt.minutes` (line 424) all exist as `"{minutes} min"`. The component uses the `account` namespace; there is no `account.minutesShort` key yet, matching the suggestion to add one or reuse `receipt.minutes`.

No grounds to refute. This is a real, in-scope, newly-introduced finding with accurate supporting evidence. Severity medium is reasonable (localization/consistency, not a functional bug).
